name: C-SSRS · Since last contact
directions: For a follow-up interview with a clinician. Ask about the period since the last contact.

questions.text: Have you wished you were dead or wished you could go to sleep and not wake up?
Have you actually had any thoughts of killing yourself?
Have you been thinking about how you might do this?
questions.hint: For example: “I thought about taking an overdose, but I never made a specific plan as to when, where or how I would actually do it … and I would never go through with it.”

questions.text: Have you had these thoughts and had some intention on acting on them?
questions.hint: As opposed to “I have thoughts, but I definitely will not do anything about them.”

questions.text: Have you started to work or worked out the details of how to kill yourself and do you intend to carry out this plan?
Have you done anything, started to do anything, or prepared to do anything to end your life?
questions.hint: Examples include preparing for an attempt, starting an attempt and stopping or being stopped, or making an attempt.
